captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a camera hot-shoe flash accessory. It features a tall, rectangular black battery body with a rear control panel including a small screen and a red slider switch. Mounted on top is an articulated cylindrical neck that connects to a boxy flash head equipped with a translucent front diffuser. A thin, light-grey bounce card slides vertically out from a slot at the top of the flash head, while a metal hot-shoe mount is located at the very bottom of the main body.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a camera hot-shoe flash. The model should include a main rectangular body with a rear-facing screen and slider controls, a cylindrical swivel neck, a tilting rectangular flash head with a front diffuser, and a sliding white bounce card that emerges from the top of the head shell.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a box primitive, adding a rear screen, slider track, and a red slider knob with offset boxes. Use a cylinder to create the vertical neck. Build the flash head by hollowing out a box using boolean subtraction to form the shell, then insert a front diffuser panel and a thin rectangular bounce card. Connect the neck to the body with a vertical revolute joint, the head to the neck with a horizontal revolute joint, and the bounce card to the head using a prismatic joint with linear limits.
